Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

HVAC Snapshot Custom Values

In our HVAC snapshot, we provide customizable values tailored to optimize your HVAC business's operations and marketing efforts. These custom values allow you to streamline processes, enhance customer satisfaction, and drive business growth effectively.

AC Giveaway Contest End Date

This value represents the end date of an AC giveaway contest funnel. It helps in managing and tracking the duration of the contest, allowing you to generate excitement and engagement among potential customers.

Customer Referral Offer

The customer referral offer is an incentive provided to existing customers for referring new clients to your HVAC business. It may include discounts, credits, or other rewards for successful referrals, encouraging word-of-mouth marketing and customer loyalty.

DR Campaign Offer

The DR (Direct Response) campaign offer is a customizable value that serves as an incentive for potential customers to engage with your HVAC services. It may include special promotions, discounts, or packages designed to attract new customers and drive conversions.

Estimate Calendar Link

This value provides a direct link to your estimate calendar, allowing potential customers to schedule HVAC service estimates conveniently. It simplifies the booking process and ensures efficient time management for both you and your customers.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management)

This link directs customers to leave continuous reviews for your HVAC business on platforms like Google. It helps in building and maintaining a positive online reputation, which is essential for attracting new customers and retaining existing ones.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign)

Similar to the continuous reputation management link, this link is associated with a specific review campaign. It prompts customers to leave reviews for your HVAC business, contributing to your online credibility and visibility.

Holiday Email Offer

The holiday email offer provides a special promotion or discount tailored for holiday seasons. It allows you to capitalize on seasonal trends and festivities to attract new customers or encourage repeat business from existing customers.

Service Area

This value specifies the geographical area where your HVAC services are available. It helps potential customers determine if your services are accessible to them and ensures accurate communication regarding service availability.

These custom values empower you to customize and optimize various aspects of your HVAC business, from marketing campaigns to service delivery, ultimately driving success and growth in the HVAC industry.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main HVAC Leads Pipeline: The main HVACleads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your HVAC-related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for yourHVAC business.

3. Calendars

HVAC Snapshot: Calendars

Calendars play a crucial role in the efficient scheduling and management of HVAC services. They help organize appointments, allocate resources, and ensure timely delivery of services to customers. In our HVAC snapshot, we offer two specialized calendars designed to streamline scheduling and optimize workflow for your HVAC business.

Estimate Calendar

The Estimate Calendar is a dedicated tool for scheduling and managing HVAC service estimates for potential customers. It facilitates the process of booking appointments for estimates, allowing your team to assess clients' needs and provide accurate pricing and service recommendations. Key features include:

Easy Appointment Booking: Enables potential customers to schedule HVAC service estimates at their convenience by selecting available time slots on the calendar.

Efficient Resource Allocation: Optimizes resource allocation by scheduling estimate appointments based on technician availability and expertise.

Automated Reminders: Sends automated reminders to customers before their scheduled estimate appointments, reducing the likelihood of no-shows and improving customer satisfaction.

Benefits:

Streamlined Scheduling: Simplifies the process of booking HVAC service estimates for potential customers, enhancing customer experience and satisfaction.

Improved Efficiency: Optimizes workflow by efficiently allocating resources and minimizing downtime between appointments, ultimately increasing productivity.

Work Calendar

The Work Calendar serves as a centralized hub for scheduling and managing HVAC service appointments and tasks for your team. It provides visibility into upcoming jobs, assignments, and service calls, allowing you to effectively plan and coordinate workflow. Key features include:

Comprehensive View: Offers a comprehensive view of scheduled HVAC service appointments, including installation, maintenance, repairs, and emergency calls.

Technician Assignments: Assigns specific jobs and tasks to individual technicians based on their availability, expertise, and location.

Real-Time Updates: Allows for real-time updates and changes to schedules, ensuring timely response to customer needs and unexpected events.

Benefits:

Enhanced Organization: Centralized scheduling and task management, improving coordination and communication among team members and reducing scheduling conflicts.

Increased Productivity: Optimizes workflow by efficiently assigning and managing HVAC service appointments, leading to improved productivity and service delivery.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the HVAC snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the HVAC Estimate Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

6. Funnels

HVAC Snapshot: Funnels

Funnels are strategic marketing frameworks designed to guide potential clients through a series of steps, ultimately leading them to take a specific action, such as booking an appointment or requesting a quote for HVAC services. In our HVAC snapshot, we offer four specialized funnels tailored to attract, engage, and convert leads effectively.

$100 Off Same Day Service Funnel

The $100 Off Same Day Service Funnel incentivizes potential clients to book HVAC services by offering a discount for same-day appointments. This funnel incorporates an opt-in process, appointment booking, and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Opt-In Process: Engages potential clients by offering a $100 discount in exchange for their contact information.

Appointment Booking: Guides clients through the process of scheduling same-day HVAC services.

Thank-You Page: Expresses gratitude to clients for booking same-day services and provides further information or instructions.

Benefits:

Conversion Incentive: Provides a compelling offer to motivate clients to schedule HVAC services promptly, driving conversions.

Immediate Service: Encourages same-day bookings, maximizing resource utilization and enhancing customer satisfaction.

AC Giveaway Funnel

The AC Giveaway Funnel creates excitement and engagement by offering clients the chance to win a free AC tune-up. This four-step funnel includes an entry contest page, survey page, appointment booking page, and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Contest Entry Page: Invites potential clients to enter the AC giveaway contest by providing their contact information.

Survey Page: Gathers additional information about potential clients' HVAC needs and preferences.

Appointment Booking Page: Offers a free AC tune-up to all participants and guides them through the process of scheduling an appointment.

Thank-You Page: Confirms entry into the contest and expresses appreciation to participants.

Benefits:

Lead Generation: Generates leads by capturing contact information and HVAC preferences from contest participants, expanding your client base.

Engagement: Creates excitement and engagement among potential clients, fostering positive brand association and customer loyalty.

HVAC Free Quote Survey Funnel

The HVAC Free Quote Survey Funnel simplifies the process of requesting a quote for HVAC services. This two-step opt-in funnel gathers client information and schedules appointments for quotes. Key features include:

Opt-In Form: Collects potential clients' contact information and details about their HVAC service needs through a simple survey.

Appointment Scheduling: Guides clients through the process of scheduling a free quote appointment for HVAC services.

Benefits:

Lead Generation: Captures contact information from potential clients interested in HVAC services, expanding your client base.

Streamlined Process: Simplifies the quote request process for clients, improving convenience and accessibility.

HVAC Tax Credit Funnel

The HVAC Tax Credit Funnel educates potential clients about available tax credits for HVAC upgrades and encourages them to book appointments for eligible services. This three-step opt-in funnel guides clients through the process of learning about tax credits, scheduling appointments, and receiving confirmation. Key features include:

Opt-In Process: Provides information about available tax credits and encourages potential clients to learn more by providing their contact information.

Appointment Booking: Guides clients through the process of scheduling appointments for HVAC services eligible for tax credits.

Confirmation Page: Confirms the successful scheduling of the appointment and provides further details or instructions.

Benefits:

Incentivized Action: Encourages potential clients to take advantage of available tax credits for HVAC upgrades, driving conversions.

Educational Outreach: Provides valuable information about tax credits, positioning your HVAC business as a trusted resource and industry expert.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the HVAC. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the HVAC, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the HVAC, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the HVAC, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your HVAC business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for your HVAC business. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign are the same and can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your HVAC business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your HVACbusiness but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your HVAC business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
